A list of reasons why certain additions, changes and artifacts in Lojban exist. It helps people explain and understand the language as is. This list would also prevent history from repeating itself. For a list of common beginner misunderstanding database see [[common beginner misunderstanding database]].
==Why does .y. exist?==
[[The god R]]

Apparently it started with [[Loglan]] which had an unofficial "drag" character ''rrr'', which eventually got incorporated with the language. From then Lojban was developed, using '''Y'''. (Folk law, until someone corrects it.)

==The mud==
The mud was a translation effort by [[Robin Lee Powell]] to translate the [[The Lojban MOO|Moo]] mud to Lojban. It began in 2005.
